mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_people (volunteer_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{volunteerId}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT volunteer_people_id AS volunteerPeopleId, volunteer_id AS volunteerId, user_id AS userId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS UpdatedAt FROM volunteer_people WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT u.name AS name, u.phone_number AS phone, u.email AS email FROM volunteer_people vp JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = vp.user_id WHERE vp.volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} ORDER BY u.name ASC
